Amendment 0001, 23 MAR 2026

MSRA/ABR Holders,

The purpose of this solicitation amendment 0001 is to add language in Section L, L-4.0 INSPECTION OF SITE / SHIP CHECK and to respond to the questions.

--------------------------------------------------------

MSRA/ABR Holders,

Notice ID: N6264926RA030

Please download the attachment files listed in Section J of the solicitation from above link.

Barge (CVE-202) FY26 Overhaul:

NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Yokosuka (NAVSUP FLCY) has a new requirement in support of Barge (CVA-8) and Commander Fleet Activity Yokosuka (CFAY) Port Operations.

The work is composed of one (1) Statement of Work (SOW) of various vessel repair, overhaul, preservation, and replacement work onboard the vessel.

Offers will be received until 13 Apr 2026, 10:00 AM (Please submit your

proposal to " kazuo.takamura.ln@us.navy.mil " in TO line)

PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: 15 Jun 2026 through 15 Sep 2026

PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Yokosuka Naval Base, Yokosuka, JAPAN

References in the Work Items will be provided to offerors via DoD safe (a

web-based tool that provides users the capability to securely send and

receive large files, including files that are too large to be transmitted

via email.)

Please email request for references to:

Kazuo Takamura (kazuo.takamura.ln@us.navy.mil)

Peter Arrieta (peterjommel.s.arrieta.ln@us.navy.mil)

When submitting your proposal, you must specify any hazardous material in

accordance with FAR 52.223-3 (Hazardous Material ID) and DFARS 252.223-7001.

When submitting your proposal, you must specify if you anticipate sea

transportation in accordance with DFARS 252.247-7022.

If there is a time limit on your offer, you must specify this at submission

of your proposal.

If there are any amendments to this RFP, please acknowledge them when

submitting your proposal in the proposal comment section.

Thank you.

--

Very Respectfully,

Kazuo Takamura

Contract Specialist

Ship Repair Team/Afloat Contracts Division (C211)

Contracting Department NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Yokosuka

DSN: 243-6187 COMM: 046-816-6187

Cell: 070-2459-0994
